value.name: review codicil provisions
value.description: The group continues reviewing the codicil, including Rosa's life tenancy and the division of the residue between Daniel and Lucia.
evidence: It also provides a life tenancy in the third-floor rooms to Rosa, terminable only at her election.
The residue of the estate, after debts and taxes, divides equally between Daniel and Lucia.

value.name: begin discussing debts
value.description: Asha moves the meeting into the estate's debts, shifting from the will's provisions to the liabilities left behind.

value.name: reveal house credit line payment
value.description: The scene reveals that Mrs. Serrano had a small line of credit on the house, which Asha has already paid down using estate funds.
evidence: Mrs. Serrano had carried a small line of credit on the house, which Asha had paid down during the week from estate funds.

value.name: disclose gas bill debt
value.description: Asha discloses that Mrs. Serrano owed the gas company money, embarrassing Daniel when he hears the amount existed at all.
evidence: She had owed the gas company a sum that had embarrassed Daniel when he learned of it.

value.name: decline personal cardiologist payment
value.description: Lucia asks to pay Mrs. Serrano's final cardiologist bill herself, but Asha refuses to avoid complicating the accounting.
evidence: She had owed her cardiologist's office a final bill that Lucia had asked, quietly, to pay personally, and Asha had told her she could not, because it would complicate the accounting, and Lucia had said all right, and they had moved on.

value.name: reveal smaller credit card balance
value.description: Asha reads out a credit card balance that is much smaller than Daniel expected, prompting his relieved reaction.
evidence: There was a credit card with a balance that Daniel had assumed was much larger than it turned out to be, and when Asha read the actual number aloud he made a small sound that was not quite a laugh.

value.name: Daniel praises her caution
value.description: Daniel remarks that Mrs. Serrano was more careful with money than he had thought.
evidence: "She was more careful than I thought," he said.

value.name: Rosa defends Mrs. Serrano's prudence
value.description: Rosa speaks for the first time since the codicil was confirmed, asserting that Mrs. Serrano was more careful than any of them realized.
evidence: "She was more careful than any of you thought," Rosa said, and it was the first thing she had said since the confirmation of the codicil,

value.name: Rosa's remark lands calmly
value.description: Rosa's statement lands without the hostility it might have carried earlier, signaling a softened emotional state in the room.
evidence: and it landed in the room without any of the edge it might have carried two weeks ago.
It was simply a statement of fact, delivered by the person in the room best positioned to know.

value.name: Asha resumes reading the will
value.description: Asha moves on to the next item in the estate proceedings, beginning the schedule of payments.
